title: Rollback triage cheatsheet - ad hoc notes
content:
Quick brain dump while triaging the canary rollback yesterday. Intended as a step-by-step checklist + command bank I can copy-paste next time. Informal, lots of TODOs and half-finished thoughts.

Symptoms observed:
- Canary pods (svc: api-canary) started 502s and TCP resets at ~10:18 UTC. Error spikes from frontend alerts, p95 latency rocket.
- Healthchecks failing after ~120s, readiness probe failing on /health with 503 body: "migration pending".
- Canary config same as stable except IMAGE_TAG and a new env FLAG_ENABLE_NEW_ROUTING.

Initial hypothesis (chronological):
1) New artifact corrupted / missing files (packaging step failed) -> entrypoint errors, readiness fails.
2) Config flag triggers a code path expecting new DB migration -> 503.
3) CI race: image tag reused/reassigned (promote step published wrong sha).

Commands I ran (save these for future):
- Check rollout status and pod logs:
  kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/api-canary --timeout=3m
  kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=api,canary=true -o wide
  kubectl -n prod logs deploy/api-canary -c api --since=30m | tail -n 200

- Inspect failing pod and exec (if Ready):
  kubectl -n prod describe pod api-canary-abcde
  kubectl -n prod exec -it api-canary-abcde -c api -- /bin/sh -c 'ls -la /app; cat /app/version.txt; echo $FLAG_ENABLE_NEW_ROUTING'

- Verify image tag / digest on registry vs deployment:
  kubectl -n prod get deploy api-canary -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
  docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api:${IMAGE_TAG}
  docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api:${IMAGE_TAG} || true
  # compare digest with k8s imageID from describe pod

- Check release pipeline logs around publish stage (CI):
  # in CI web UI, search pipeline REL-1182 and check `tag-and-push` step logs.

Actual snippets I saw in logs:
- app stderr:
  2025-01-17T10:18:09Z ERROR startup: missing migration manifest /app/migrations/0003_add_routes.sql
  2025-01-17T10:18:09Z FATAL exiting: required file not present

- kubernetes events:
  10:18:12 Normal Killing pod/api-canary-abcde Container failed liveness probe

What this pointed to:
- Missing migration file inside container -> packaging problem during build. But why only canary? Canary used freshly-built image (candidate tag) while stable uses semver-pinned image. So candidate likely packaged from wrong workspace (e.g., partial workspace in CI runner).

Tried quick mitigation:
- Promoted previous stable image to canary (force-promote):
  # quick patch to k8s deployment
  kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api-canary api=ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api:2025.01.10-rc2
  kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/api-canary --timeout=2m
  # monitoring: errors subsided within 2 minutes; p95 returned to baseline

Deeper debugging steps I ran after mitigation:
- Pulled failing candidate image locally and inspected contents:
  docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api:candidate-2025-01-17-485
  docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api:candidate-2025-01-17-485 /bin/sh -c 'ls -1 /app | sed -n "1,200p"'
  # observed no migrations dir -> packaging bug confirmed

- Cross-check with build artifacts from CI storage:
  # artifact list in CI-run: artifact://ci/rel-1182/build/485/api.tar.gz
  # downloaded and inspected sha256, metadata showed missing step `scripts/copy-migrations.sh` in artifact list

Hypothesis on root cause:
- The `publish-image` job depends on earlier `package-artifact` job, but the runner used a cached workspace and an artifact copy step was skipped for this ephemeral runner due to a flaky artifact download. Effect: image built from incomplete workspace snapshot.
- Alternatively, packaging script uses `rsync --delete` and a bad exclude pattern removed migrations when source tree had a trailing slash. Need to reproduce locally.

Recovery notes for postmortem:
- Temporary rollback to previous image prevented customer impact.
- CI job should enforce an explicit `ls -la` and `sha256sum` of tarball during publish step (fail-safe).
- Add an early CI assertion: verify presence of /app/migrations/*.sql before building container.

Immediate follow-ups (for next 48h):
- Re-run the packaging job locally with same CI runner image to reproduce. Steps:
  1) checkout commit (git rev-parse HEAD) -> record commit sha and compare to CI logs
  2) run `bazel build //services/api:package` or `make package` using exact runner image
  3) inspect artifact tar and confirm migrations folder present

- Add automation: in release pipeline `tag-and-push` step add a verification script:
  ./ci/verify_artifact_contents.sh api candidate-485 
  # script should exit non-zero if key files missing

Snippets to copy into PR for hotfix in CI:
- verify_artifact_contents.sh (concept):
  #!/bin/sh
  set -e
  tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
  curl -fsS "$CI_ARTIFACT_URL" -o "$tmpdir/art.tar.gz"
  tar -tzf "$tmpdir/art.tar.gz" | grep -q 'migrations/0003_add_routes.sql' || { echo 'missing migration' >&2; exit 2; }
  echo 'artifact ok'

Other observations / TODOs (brain dump):
- Why did kubernetes not surfacing explicit file errors earlier? maybe entrypoint catches and prints generic 'startup failed' -> improve entrypoint logging to include file listing on startup error (dev parity).
- Consider blocking canary promotion until smoke-test container-level assertions pass (smoke test runner that checks key files and a quick DB connectivity check).
- Ticket: REL-1182 updated notes + label `postmortem-needed` if we find CI root cause reproducible.

Quick pasteable timeline for report:
- 10:12 UTC: canary promotion started by pipeline REL-1182 (candidate-485)
- 10:17 UTC: first 502 alerts from frontend
- 10:19 UTC: SRE paged, triage -> found missing migration inside image
- 10:25 UTC: rolled back canary to image 2025.01.10-rc2 -> errors subsided by 10:28

Useful artifacts (local copy paths / refs):
- /home/asha/tmp/rel-1182-artifact-485/ -> downloaded tar and extracted list.txt
- git rev: 9f8c3e2a (candidate tagging commit)

Next actions assigned to: (informal)
- Marcus: reproduce packaging failure on runner image and attach logs (48h)
- Lydia: draft PR adding verify_artifact_contents.sh to CI and add pipeline assertion (24h)
- Asha (me): update REL-1182 ticket with timeline and add rollback notes (now)

Notes to self: keep this scrap doc short and move cleaned version to shared_drives/release-engineering/postmortems/REL-1182 when we have root cause.

End of scratchpad.

Add smoke-tests gating canary promotion (file existence + simple endpoint test)
Schedule postmortem meeting with SRE and CI owners
Audit recent tag/publish jobs for similar failures in last 90 days
